context: Tests whether the agent creates a RULE.md that enforces a specific, literal Python docstring convention with directive-form bullets grouped by concern, stays under 100 lines, puts one convention per bullet, and validates against the provided Python source files.

checklist.name: Lowercase-hyphenated rule name
checklist.description: The directory containing RULE.md has a lowercase hyphenated name (e.g., python-docstrings, docstring-style, python-docs-convention) — not CamelCase, snake_case, or containing spaces

checklist.name: # Heading in RULE.md
checklist.description: RULE.md begins with a # heading (ATX-style) stating the rule name

checklist.name: Grouped by concern
checklist.description: RULE.md uses ## section headings to separate distinct concerns (e.g., separate sections for one-liners vs. multi-line docstrings, or for parameters vs. return values)

checklist.name: Specific docstring style chosen
checklist.description: RULE.md specifies exactly one docstring style (e.g., Google, NumPy, or reStructuredText/Sphinx) — it does NOT say 'pick any consistent style' or leave the choice open

checklist.name: Directive form used
checklist.description: Conventions use imperative form ('Use X', 'Document Y', 'Omit Z') rather than hedged or explanatory form ('You should use X', 'It is recommended', 'Consider')

checklist.name: No rationale or explanations
checklist.description: RULE.md does NOT contain sentences explaining why a convention exists — only the convention itself as a directive

checklist.name: One convention per bullet
checklist.description: No bullet point contains two distinct conventions joined by 'and', 'also', or a semicolon

checklist.name: Under 100 lines
checklist.description: RULE.md has fewer than 100 lines (including blank lines, headings, and bullets)

checklist.name: Validation covers multiple input files
checklist.description: validation-report.md names at least two of the three provided files (parser.py, validator.py, formatter.py) as files that were examined

checklist.name: Validation identifies style conflicts
checklist.description: validation-report.md notes at least one specific inconsistency or conflict found in the examined files (e.g., identifies that Google-style and NumPy-style both appear, or that some functions use comments instead of docstrings)
